title: Mossland Ecosystem Registry
description: Machine-readable registry of verified Mossland domains, ecosystem apps, labs, channels, and third-party market references. Source of truth for links.moss.land and for Passport ecosystem-stamp domain verification.

version.description: Semantic version of the registry document.

rubricVersion.description: Semantic version of the editorial rubric declared in `rubric`. Distinct from `version`, which versions this document's contents: an entry can stay byte-identical while the rubric that classified it changes meaning. Bump per the rules in assurance/RUBRIC.md. Consumers that act on stampClass — notably Passport, which weights ecosystem stamps — should treat a change here as a signal to re-check their assumptions.

rubric.description: The editorial rubric of record: how a service's fields map to the trust chip shown on the page, and what each Passport stampClass signifies. build/generate.mjs derives both the chip and the on-page legend from this object, so the rendered page cannot drift from the declared rubric.

stampWeighting.description: Where numeric stamp weighting is decided. This registry declares what a stampClass signifies, not a weight.

precedence.description: Ordered chip-derivation rules; first match wins. The final entry must be the catch-all rule with `when` set to "default".

when.description: Either the string "default" (catch-all) or a condition object: {artifact:true}, {chipOverride:true}, {tier}, {owner}, {status}, or {anyOf:[...]}.

legendOrder.description: Display order of the on-page legend. Every name must have a definition.

definitions.description: Per-chip presentation class, accessible label, and bilingual meaning.

stampClasses.description: What each stampClass signifies. Must cover every stampClass value used by a service.

section.description: Primary visible section the service renders in. null = registry-only, not rendered.

extraSections.description: Additional sections to also render this service in. Currently unused; reserved for a service that must appear in more than one section.

passportEligible.description: Whether this domain may back a Passport ecosystem stamp. MUST be false for all third_party/market and off-domain channel entries.

stampType.description: Namespaced Passport stamp id (e.g. identity_holder, intelligence_reader). null when not eligible.

stampClass.description: Significance tier of the Passport stamp this service backs, so stamps can be weighted rather than treated as a flat attendance log. core=identity/holder, governance=binding decision acts, participation=recurring community activity, connect=lightweight verified-domain visit, lab=experimental observer, showcase=experience visit. null when not passportEligible.

hidden.description: If true, kept in the registry but not rendered on the page.

artifact.description: Developer data file (registry/llms/sitemap) — renders with a muted secondary chip, not a trust-tier chip.

chip.description: Opt a non-labs service into the amber 실험 (experimental) chip (e.g. media). Labs-tier services get 실험 automatically without this field.

runtime.description: Optional nested runtime app (e.g. play.wa under wa).
